milestones.title: YouTube launches
milestones.text: The platform begins, creating a new home for user-created video.

milestones.title: Early creator era
milestones.text: Channels such as Smosh help establish the idea of YouTube personalities.

milestones.title: MrBeast joins
milestones.text: Jimmy Donaldson creates the channel that would later become a global creator business.

milestones.title: 100M club expands
milestones.text: T-Series and PewDiePie become early channels to receive the Red Diamond Creator Award.

milestones.title: MrBeast passes 100M
milestones.text: MrBeast joins the 100 million subscriber club and becomes the largest individual creator.

milestones.title: MrBeast takes the overall lead
milestones.text: MrBeast becomes YouTube's most-subscribed channel, passing T-Series.

milestones.title: 500M milestone
milestones.text: YouTube says MrBeast became the first individual creator to reach 500 million subscribers.
